correctness.rationale: Lemma 2.1 (squarefree colon combinatorics, v(I(G))=min|A| stable with N(A) a minimal vertex cover) is proved correctly and matches Grisalde-Reyes-Villarreal Thm 3.5/Thm 4.1. G* (edges 12,34,56,27,47,67): A={7} stable, N(A)={2,4,6}, residual {1,3,5} edgeless so (I:x7)=(x2,x4,x6); minimality via private edges 12/34/56; v=1 since graph nonempty; matching {12,34,56} pairwise disjoint with no chords inside {1..6} (other edges go to hub 7), im=3 with upper bound floor(7/2). Independently recomputed: v=1/A=[6]/C=[1,3,5], im=3. H* (0-indexed 01,03,15,16,23,25,36,45,56): A={6} stable, N={1,3,5}, residual {0,2,4} edgeless so (I:x6)=(x1,x3,x5); private edges 16/36/45 give minimality; v=1. Matching {03,45} induced (no 04,05,34,35 edges), im>=2; all 7 disjoint edge-triples enumerated and each carries a chord (independently re-enumerated: 7 triples, each with >=1 chord), so im=2. Outside-all conditions verified edge-by-edge: triangle 1-5-6 (non-bipartite); minimal covers of sizes 3 ({1,3,5}) and 5 ({0,1,2,4,6}, each vertex with checked private edge 03/15/23/45/36) so not well-covered; induced C4 on {0,1,3,6} (exactly 01,03,16,36) and on {2,3,5,6} (exactly 23,25,36,56), induced C5 on {0,1,2,3,5} (exactly 01,03,15,23,25, all degrees 2); unique simplicial vertex 4 (N(4)={5} clique; all others have two non-adjacent neighbours, checked); hence no simplicial partition under either closed-neighbourhood-block or clique-block formulation (at most one block, V not a clique); |V|=7 odd so not whisker/very-well-covered. Labeled-tree census independently re-executed via Prufer enumeration: 16807 trees, distribution (1,1):637, (1,2):5250, (1,3):840, (2,2):10080, gap count 6090, matching the claim exactly. No Gröbner computation beyond Lemma 2.1 is needed; proof/computation/conjecture are separated and the uncompleted 853-graph census is honestly disclaimed.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively: Grisalde-Reyes-Villarreal (2109.14121) proves v<=im only under very-well-covered / simplicial-partition / well-covered-connected-no-C4-C5 hypotheses and classifies cycles (C5 exception v=2>im=1) — no 7-vertex census, no strict-gap witness outside all hypotheses. Saha-Sengupta (2111.12881) proves v<=im<=reg only for bipartite / (C4,C5)-free vertex-decomposable / whisker graphs plus disconnected v>reg+1 examples and reg arbitrarily above v — no exhaustive (v,im) window table or outside-all strict-gap graph. Saha-Van Tuyl (2507.05700) studies (v,deg-h) with minimal 11-vertex examples — different invariant pair. arXiv search 'v-number edge ideal induced matching' returns 6 hits, none a 7-vertex (v,im) census or these witnesses. No source publishes H* (outside-all (1,2)), G* tree (1,3) gap 2, or the 16807-tree (v,im) distribution. Claim is substantively distinct from internal priors (SCOPE004 ladder reg=im; SCOPE-FAIL-040 reg/pdim maxima).

value.rationale: Headline H* is an independently retrievable exact datum: a specific 7-vertex graph with certified (v,im)=(1,2) lying outside every published sufficient hypothesis for v<=im (non-bipartite, not well-covered, induced C4 and C5 present, no simplicial partition, odd order), directly testing necessity/boundary of those theorems in the recognized 'when does v fall strictly below im' program (coding-theoretic motivation established before computation). G* gives a clean tree witness with gap 2. The complete labeled-tree census (exact distribution over all 7^5 trees, 36.2% strict gap) is a natural-stratum exact invariant, not known or mechanically implied, reusable for hypothesis testing. Judged as headline exact results, not as a general theorem; the honestly-disclaimed incomplete 853-graph census does not erase them. Not textbook, not parameter substitution, not an unexplained enumeration.

residual_risks: Committed replay.py main() asserts G* and runs the tree census plus a superset search but does not assert the H* headline values inline; H* is hand-proved edge-by-edge and verified here by independent script calls, and cert.json records it, but a one-line H* assert would tighten the replay artifact.

Simplicial-partition exact-cover code tests the closed-neighbourhood-block formulation; the DRAFT hand argument covers the clique-block variant (unique simplicial vertex => at most one block => V not a clique), so the conclusion is robust but cross-formulation equivalence is argued by hand, not by code.
